I can’t find any NHANES lab variable named LBXFAKE in the public codebooks or data dictionaries (through the most recent 2021–2022 release), and I’m not aware of any NHANES analyte described as a “perfluorinated diol.” Because of that, I can’t cite NHANES cycles or effect sizes for LBXFAKE—there don’t appear to be published associations for a variable by that name.

If you meant a specific PFAS measured in NHANES (e.g., perfluorooctanoic acid LBXPFOA, perfluorooctane sulfonate LBXPFOS, perfluorohexane sulfonic acid LBXPFHXS, perfluorononanoic acid LBXPFNA, perfluorodecanoic acid LBXPFDA, perfluoroundecanoic acid LBXPFUN), I can summarize their strongest health associations and provide cycle- and effect-size–specific citations. Please share the exact variable code or the PFAS name you have in mind (and the cycle/file you saw “LBXFAKE” in). If this is a restricted-use variable, a custom composite, or a placeholder, a codebook link or label text would let me pull the right evidence.

If helpful in the meantime, I can also run a quick, survey-weighted NHANES screen once we pin down the variable: specify cycles, outcomes (e.g., total/LDL cholesterol, uric acid, eGFR, ALT, thyroid hormones, HOMA-IR, BP), and covariates, and I’ll return the strongest associations with effect sizes and multiple-testing control.
